steps.name: Validate input values
steps.description: Checks that currentTime, start and duration are finite integers within 0-1440 before any booking logic runs.

config.failureMessage: All time values must be whole numbers between 0 and 1440.

steps.name: Reject past start
steps.description: The requested start must be strictly after the simulated current time.

config.failureMessage: Start must be strictly after the current time.

steps.name: Enforce duration range
steps.description: Duration must be between 1 and 120 minutes inclusive.

config.failureMessage: Duration must be between 1 and 120 minutes.

steps.name: Check room blocked
steps.description: If the room is blocked, no booking is accepted at all.

steps.name: Check booking overlap
steps.description: Rejects the request if it overlaps booking 600-660; touching endpoints are allowed.

steps.name: Approve booking
steps.description: All guards passed; the slot is available.
